rationale.nominal: Low application latency and no intentional drops provide the prospective efficiency reference.
rationale.moderate: Ten percent independent loss and moderate jitter are candidate settings to validate before the main experiment.
rationale.severe: Thirty percent independent loss plus rate and bandwidth constraints inherit the pinned pilot calibration, subject to verification.
rationale.partitioned: A temporary thirty-second split isolates half the team from the other half and the fleet controller; usefulness requires validation.
rationale.scenario_family: The same four frozen waypoint routes and safety geometry are used across architectures; this benchmark measures route work, not sensed area coverage.
rationale.selection_reason: Begin with all architecture, communication and failure combinations for two and four drones; validate eight drones as a separately frozen extension.
